contract.input: A versioned JSON profile binds a workload id/revision, exact core repository/revision/tree, CLI artifact SHA-256 built by the harness in a fresh isolated Cargo target, release/toolchain versions, repetition counts, timeouts, and a fixed argument-vector workflow.
contract.workload: Run the core local task CLI's NativeMacos/NativeCpu demo. Each trial starts a fresh local service, times readiness and the first demo request as cold samples, then times three demo requests against that same service as warm samples.
contract.output: A versioned JSON result binds the profile/workload digests, exact core SHA/tree, CLI binary SHA-256, isolated locked offline build command, Rust version, macOS version, architecture, and chip model. Every attempted sample remains a record with passed/failed/unmeasured status, nullable duration, exit code, and stable error code.
contract.privacy: Use an isolated private temporary data directory and a sanitized child environment. Record no serial number, hardware UUID, account name, absolute path, secret, model weight, or private training data.

acceptance_mapping.check: Three cold/warm trial groups bind exact source/artifact/environment; all repetitions are preserved. Unit tests cover failed samples, null/unmeasured metrics, and result round trips. A real M4 Pro NativeCpu CLI run produces a public JSON result without claiming Metal/WebGPU/model evidence.

risks: The native CLI workload does not measure GPU, Metal, WebGPU, or model execution; those remain explicit unmeasured values.
Timings are device- and environment-specific observations, not performance thresholds or cross-device claims.
The harness runs only a fixed local argument vector, with no shell, secrets, or arbitrary issue-sourced commands.

tools_and_roles.architect_implementer_verifier: Codex, GPT-6 family; exact model SKU is not exposed in this task context.
tools_and_roles.independent_reviewer: g16_review separate Codex context; pending exact final head.

rollback: Revert the scoped PR; remove the generated result artifact if it should not be retained. No external service or persistent user data is modified.
